verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a Resend free tier or trial, or what sending limits would apply to one. The pricing excerpts mention only paid Pro and Scale add-ons and dedicated IP warmup. The only 'starts free' remark (resend-comm-4) is about Postmark, a competitor, so it does not transfer to Resend.

support.subject: As a founder, I can integrate and validate the service on a free tier or trial that allows real deliveries to my own users, not just a demo
